question: to the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Siegbert Frank Droese (ESN) Subject:

What is the opinion of the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning French President Macron’s creation of an ‘anti-ballistic coalition’ against Russia?
Does the Vice-President / High Representative agree with Macron’s statement that Europe must defend itself ‘if necessary with blood’?
